lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me. I’m really glad you said it out loud. Since you’re scared about tonight, this is urgent support right now. If you feel you might act on those thoughts or you’re in immediate danger, call nine one one now. If you can stay safe right now, stay with me and I’ll connect you to a live two one one specialist immediately.
